name: IAPO synthetic benchmark
description: Executable IAPO synthetic benchmark and empirical reanalysis for manuscript plants-4622842, second-round revision. Includes all 50 synthetic datasets, the unmodified CC BY 4.0 source supplement from Lin et al. (2024, doi:10.3390/ijms25168840), derived inputs, source attribution, explicit sample splits, selected panels, individual predictions, complete numerical results and executable checks. The empirical analysis uses normalized segregation states from 164 offspring in one C. oleifera full-sib family and two observed traits; it does not establish resolved polyploid dosage accuracy or cross-family transfer.
